scenario.expectation: The positive ingredient should add 3 and may bring target into Top-3; existing constraints hold.
The negative method should subtract 3 and not improve target rank; it is a soft preference, not an exclusion.
The target is already in baseline Top-3; report preservation rather than counting it as a newly achieved hit.
The ghost ingredient matches no recipe; no memory matches either viable recipe and ranking remains identical.
Only the 25-minute neutral wok recipe remains and its ranking and score do not change.
A recipe within the remembered 20-minute tendency receives 3 points; baseline may already rank it highly.
Both groups reject the forbidden, too-slow, wrong-equipment, and known-over-budget recipes.
All candidates violate the time constraint; neither group returns a candidate.

protocol.metrics: Top-1/Top-3 use target presence for positive cases and target absence for the negative case, only S1,S2,S3,S6,S7. Retrieval hit uses each case's stated relevant_memory. S4,S5,S8 are excluded from preference-rate denominators and assess no-signal stability. Report per-case results and retrieval of the unrelated memory separately.
protocol.safety: No real user data, no real Agent model, no automatic write retry after unknown result, unique synthetic user, verify ownership and IDs before cleanup; no relaxed safety constraints. Budget reserves at least 22 remote calls before each scenario pair for cleanup.
